nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) storing token balances of each account.
Private nested mapping storing spender allowances approved by owners.
Private uint256 holding the total token supply.
Private string holding the ERC20 token name ('FlokiNoke').
Private string holding the ERC20 token symbol ('NOKEY').
Private address storing the contract owner used by the Ownable access-control checks.
Internal view helper from Context returning msg.sender.
Internal virtual token transfer that checks addresses, calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook and updates _balances.
Internal mint function that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account].
Internal burn function that decreases _balances[account] and _totalSupply.
Internal approval function that sets _allowances[owner][spender].
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards to _transfer using _msgSender() as sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that transfers tokens and reduces the caller allowance via SafeMath sub.
Public ERC20 approve that sets allowance from the caller to spender.
Public function atomically increasing the caller's allowance to spender.
Public function atomically decreasing the caller's allowance to spender.
Public view returning _balances[account].
onlyOwner function that permanently sets _owner to address(0).
onlyOwner function that reassigns _owner to newOwner.
Deployment constructor that sets name/symbol and mints the whole 1e9*1e18 supply to msg.sender.
External payable receive fallback that accepts plain Ether transfers.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, ownership checks and allowance ownership.
Privileged one-time mint of totalSupply to msg.sender inside the constructor (creates all tokens for the deployer).
Irreversible write of _owner = address(0) performed by renounceOwnership.
Privileged write of _owner = newOwner performed by transferOwnership.
Empty internal hook invoked by _transfer, _mint and _burn before any balance change.
Recipient address parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
Token amount parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
Sender address parameter of transferFrom whose allowance is spent.
Spender address parameter of approve that receives the allowance.
Amount added to the caller's allowance in increaseAllowance.
Amount removed from the caller's allowance in decreaseAllowance.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Local variable in the FlokiNoke constructor holding 1 * 1e9 * 1e18 tokens minted to msg.sender.

edges.reason: _msgSender returns the caller-controlled msg.sender value.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the token movement.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
The entire minted supply is credited to the untrusted caller msg.sender in the constructor.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender with _owner.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender with _owner.
The onlyOwner check reads _owner before allowing renounceOwnership to execute.
The onlyOwner check reads _owner before allowing transferOwnership to execute.
The constructor invokes the internal _mint routine.
The constructor execution path performs the one-time supply mint.
The constructor mint operation routes through _mint(account, amount).
_mint credits the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_transfer debits the sender and credits the recipient in _balances.
transferFrom reads and decreases the allowance entry in _allowances.
_approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
_burn debits the target account in _balances.
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
transfer calls the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom calls the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
approve calls the internal _approve routine.
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the new allowance value.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the reduced allowance value.
renounceOwnership executes the privileged owner-zeroing operation.
The renounce operation overwrites the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership executes the privileged owner reassignment operation.
The transfer-ownership operation overwrites the _owner state variable.
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are updated.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state updates.
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state updates.
The recipient parameter flows into _transfer as the credit target.
The amount parameter flows into _transfer as the moved value.
The sender parameter of transferFrom flows into _transfer as the debit target.
The spender parameter flows into _approve as the allowance beneficiary.
The addedValue parameter flows into _approve as the new allowance amount.
The subtractedValue parameter flows into _approve as the reduced allowance amount.
The newOwner parameter is written into the _owner state variable by transferOwnership.
The local totalSupply value is the amount passed to the constructor mint operation.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient is a transient argument only meaningful as the credit target inside _transfer.
Amount is a transient argument only meaningful as the transferred value inside _transfer.
Sender parameter is only meaningful as the debit target passed into _transfer.
Spender parameter is only meaningful as the allowance beneficiary inside _approve.
addedValue exists only to feed the new allowance into the approval logic.
subtractedValue exists only to feed the reduced allowance into the approval logic.
newOwner is consumed directly by the privileged owner reassignment write.
The local totalSupply is used once as the amount of the constructor mint to msg.sender.
